queries.search_text: site:single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu 2025 late payments SMEs European Payment Observatory report
queries.proposition: The European Commission reports that late payments remain widespread, payment periods exceed sixty days on average in both business and government transactions, larger firms are less likely to pay on time, and collection imposes administrative burden; this supports testing supplier-side products that reduce delay, uncertainty, and collection effort.
queries.status: SUPPORTED FOR THE PROBLEM; WILLINGNESS TO PAY UNKNOWN
queries.contradiction: Payment performance varies substantially by Member State, and the source does not show that Polish buyers or suppliers will pay for any proposed intervention.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Interview ten Polish SME finance owners with overdue invoices and ask each to submit one real invoice to a manual paid pilot with an explicit fee or success charge.

queries.search_text: site:uokik.gov.pl pompy ciepła kontrola 2025 wyniki nieprawidłowości
queries.source_title: Pompy ciepła – wspólne działania UOKiK, IH i KAS
queries.proposition: Polish authorities found documentation, labeling, and declaration problems in most inspected non-EU heat-pump models and state that missing records deprive buyers of information and evidence needed to judge compliance and safety; this supports testing independent verification and accountability services.
queries.status: SUPPORTED FOR A FORMAL-COMPLIANCE AND INFORMATION GAP; TECHNICAL FAILURE AND WILLINGNESS TO PAY UNKNOWN
queries.contradiction: The inspection was primarily formal, some defects may be remediable paperwork, and planned technical testing means the source does not establish poor real-world efficiency or safety for the inspected units.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Offer a manual document-and-registry verification on twenty live heat-pump quotes through two installers and measure whether households, installers, importers, or lenders pay for the report.

concepts.title: Milestone Proof Rail for Public Contractors
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A neutral evidence workflow packages construction milestones into submission-ready payment claims and flags buyer-side omissions before they become disputed invoices.
concepts.customer: Small construction and renewable-installation subcontractors serving municipalities or large general contractors
concepts.loss_event: A completed milestone is rejected, queried, or left unpaid because evidence is incomplete or scattered
concepts.beneficiary: Subcontractor finance team and project manager
concepts.authority_holder: Contracting authority or general contractor approving the milestone
concepts.distributor: Construction accountants, tender advisers, and trade associations
concepts.risk_bearer: Subcontractor carrying payroll and material costs during delay
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed-fee review and assembly of one live milestone claim
concepts.acquisition_route: Partner referrals from accountants serving public-works suppliers
concepts.compounding_asset: Anonymized library of rejection reasons, evidence checklists, and payer-specific acceptance patterns
hypotheses: Documentation defects materially cause avoidable payment delay in the target contracts
A supplier will pay before submission rather than only after a dispute
Contract documents can be processed lawfully with scoped access and data minimization
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not rely on fabricated completion evidence, concealed defects, or improper influence over procurement officials.

concepts.title: Clinic Receivable Exception Desk
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A managed exception desk reconciles rejected healthcare invoices against contracts and payer requirements, then prepares lawful corrections and escalation packs.
concepts.customer: Independent clinics, diagnostic providers, and medical suppliers
concepts.loss_event: A payer rejects or delays an invoice because codes, attachments, authorizations, or contract terms do not align
concepts.beneficiary: Provider finance team and clinical operation
concepts.authority_holder: Public or private healthcare payer controlling acceptance
concepts.distributor: Medical accounting firms and practice-management vendors
concepts.risk_bearer: Provider financing staff and consumables while payment is unresolved
concepts.first_paid_event: A fee for resolving one rejected invoice batch
concepts.acquisition_route: Outbound offers to providers identified through public directories and accounting partners
concepts.compounding_asset: Payer-specific rejection taxonomy and correction playbooks
hypotheses: A recurring share of delays is operationally correctable rather than a substantive coverage dispute
Providers can share minimum necessary records under an appropriate data-processing agreement
Recovered staff time and accelerated cash justify a service fee
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not rely on upcoding, false clinical records, unauthorized access to health data, or evasion of payer rules.

concepts.title: Buyer Payment Friction Passport
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: An evidence-backed buyer passport lets small suppliers compare actual onboarding, dispute, and payment friction before accepting concentrated exposure.
concepts.customer: Exporting and domestic SMEs considering large unfamiliar buyers
concepts.loss_event: A supplier accepts a commercially attractive order but later encounters long approval chains or habitual payment delay
concepts.authority_holder: Prospective buyer controlling purchase and payment terms
concepts.distributor: Export advisers, invoice-finance brokers, and industry associations
concepts.first_paid_event: Purchase of a diligence report on one prospective buyer
concepts.acquisition_route: Search-led acquisition around buyer due diligence plus broker referrals
concepts.compounding_asset: Consent-based, normalized database of payment workflows and verified supplier experiences
hypotheses: Suppliers can contribute verifiable evidence without breaching confidentiality
Operational payment friction predicts losses beyond conventional credit scores
A pre-contract decision is valuable enough to support report fees
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not rely on defamatory anonymous accusations, confidential-data leakage, blackmail, or unverifiable payment claims.

concepts.title: Accepted-Invoice Advance Cooperative
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A software-led broker pools small, already-accepted invoices and routes them to licensed funders so micro-suppliers can access pricing usually reserved for larger books.
concepts.customer: Microbusinesses with accepted invoices to creditworthy enterprises or public bodies
concepts.loss_event: The supplier cannot fund payroll or materials while waiting through the buyer's payment cycle
concepts.payer: Supplier through a disclosed financing or brokerage fee
concepts.authority_holder: Licensed funding partner approving an advance
concepts.distributor: Bookkeepers, payroll bureaus, and small-business software vendors
concepts.risk_bearer: Licensed funder, subject to the final contract structure
concepts.first_paid_event: Closing of the first funded accepted invoice
concepts.compounding_asset: Performance data on payer, document quality, acceptance state, and realized payment timing
hypotheses: Licensed funders will price pooled small invoices attractively
Acceptance status can be verified cheaply and reliably
Broker economics remain viable after fraud controls and customer support
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not lend or intermediate regulated credit without required authorization, misstate recourse, or double-assign invoices.

concepts.title: Prompt-Pay Supplier Exchange
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A procurement channel gives mid-market buyers discounted access to vetted local suppliers in exchange for short, verifiable payment terms and automated acceptance rules.
concepts.customer: Cash-constrained specialist suppliers and mid-market buyers with recurring indirect procurement
concepts.loss_event: Suppliers embed financing risk into prices or refuse attractive orders, while buyers lose reliable capacity
concepts.payer: Buyer through a procurement subscription or transaction fee
concepts.authority_holder: Buyer procurement and treasury leaders setting terms
concepts.distributor: Regional business chambers and procurement consultants
concepts.risk_bearer: Buyer for timely payment and supplier for delivery quality
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid sourcing sprint governed by prompt-payment terms
concepts.acquisition_route: Direct outreach to buyers with fragmented maintenance, installation, and specialist-service spend
concepts.compounding_asset: Verified supplier performance and buyer payment-behavior graph
hypotheses: Buyers will trade shorter terms for better supplier pricing or availability
Payment timing can be verified without exposing sensitive bank data
A focused category has enough repeat volume for marketplace liquidity
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not rely on sham bidding, undisclosed kickbacks, exclusionary collusion, or misleading payment certifications.

concepts.title: Heat-Pump Quote Passport
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: An independent pre-purchase report verifies each quoted model's documents, registry trail, supplier identity, sizing inputs, and warranty handoffs before a household signs.
concepts.customer: Polish homeowners comparing heat-pump installation quotes
concepts.loss_event: A household commits to a costly system without reliable compliance, performance, or accountability information
concepts.authority_holder: Homeowner deciding whether to sign and finance
concepts.distributor: Independent energy auditors, mortgage advisers, and consumer associations
concepts.risk_bearer: Homeowner bearing purchase, operating, and remediation costs
concepts.first_paid_event: Purchase of a report on one live quote
concepts.acquisition_route: Search-led acquisition around model verification and quote comparison
concepts.compounding_asset: Versioned model-document registry, installer handoff map, and observed quote defects
hypotheses: Households will pay for verification before signing rather than seek free advice
Public and supplier records are sufficient to detect material gaps
Installers will tolerate independent scrutiny without blocking access
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not present a document review as a statutory certification or guarantee technical performance not actually tested.

concepts.title: Importer Compliance Workbench
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A structured workbench assembles, validates, versions, and hands off the required heat-pump product records before customs or distributor onboarding.
concepts.customer: Small EU heat-pump importers and private-label distributors
concepts.loss_event: A shipment is delayed or rejected because product records, labeling, declarations, or registry entries are missing or inconsistent
concepts.beneficiary: Importer operations team and downstream reseller
concepts.authority_holder: Importer legally responsible for market placement, with authorities retaining enforcement power
concepts.distributor: Customs brokers, testing laboratories, and renewable-equipment wholesalers
concepts.risk_bearer: Importer carrying inventory and compliance exposure
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed-fee readiness review for one model and shipment
concepts.acquisition_route: Referral agreements with customs brokers and laboratories
concepts.compounding_asset: Requirement graph, defect taxonomy, reusable evidence templates, and change history by model
hypotheses: Importers experience recurring, costly record defects before clearance
A non-legal workflow layer can shorten remediation time
Customers will pay per model before a shipment is at risk
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not forge declarations, conceal failed tests, impersonate a notified body, or promise regulatory approval.

concepts.title: Installer Warranty Continuity Vault
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A portable installation record preserves commissioning data, component identities, service actions, and responsibility handoffs when the original installer disappears or disputes coverage.
concepts.customer: Regional heat-pump installers, housing cooperatives, and equipment lenders
concepts.loss_event: A service or warranty claim stalls because installation evidence is missing, fragmented, or controlled by a defunct contractor
concepts.beneficiary: Property owner and replacement service provider
concepts.distributor: Equipment wholesalers, lenders, and installer networks
concepts.risk_bearer: Property owner unless warranty or service contract accepts the claim
concepts.transaction_owner: Installer operations lead or housing manager
concepts.first_paid_event: Activation fee for the first installation record
concepts.acquisition_route: Bundle through wholesalers and financing partners at installation
concepts.compounding_asset: Longitudinal component, commissioning, fault, and service-history dataset
hypotheses: Missing installation records materially delay warranty and service resolution
Installers will capture evidence at commissioning if the workflow is lightweight
Manufacturers or lenders will recognize portable records in claims workflows
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not alter commissioning records after the fact, invent service history, or claim that record storage forces warranty acceptance.

concepts.title: Measured Heat Guarantee Underwriter
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A measurement service establishes a weather-adjusted post-installation baseline and sells installers or lenders the evidence layer needed to offer narrowly bounded performance remedies.
concepts.customer: Heat-pump installers, retrofit lenders, and housing cooperatives
concepts.loss_event: A system consumes more energy or delivers less comfort than expected, but neither side has credible evidence separating equipment, sizing, building, and operating causes
concepts.beneficiary: Property owner and accountable service provider
concepts.authority_holder: Contracting party adjudicating the bounded remedy, with any insurance carrier controlling insured payouts
concepts.distributor: Renewable-installation firms, energy auditors, and retrofit lenders
concepts.risk_bearer: Initially the installer under a capped service remedy; a licensed insurer only if separately contracted
concepts.transaction_owner: Installer owner or lender product lead
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid baseline study for one completed installation
concepts.acquisition_route: Pilot through a regional installation firm and its recent customer base
concepts.compounding_asset: Weather-normalized performance curves linked to building attributes, equipment, installation choices, and faults
hypotheses: Low-cost sensors and utility data can produce decision-grade attribution
Installers gain enough sales conversion or dispute reduction to pay
A narrow service remedy can avoid unintended insurance regulation
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not market an insurance product without authorization or overstate causal attribution from incomplete sensor data.
